budget_selection_rule: Choose the smallest common candidate at or above the previously observed normalized P0 causal floor, with nonzero actions for every rho, coherence >=0.95, degeneration <=0.05, and q_max <=0.30; do not use rho safety outcomes.
budget_dev_amendment: The initial 0.20 peak cap made target 0.10 infeasible only for rho=0.44 (q_max=0.23163) despite coherence=1.000. Before protocol freeze and without inspecting safety outcomes, the cap was set to 0.30. This provisional calibration was later invalidated when the corrected clean-sigma behavioral gate failed.
